fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

No matter how powerful and flexible you build a platform, at the end of the day it’s the presentation and intuitive marketing design that helps relate to the user and helps define their experience! In order to help us do this, RDX Works is seeking a savvy Graphic Designer to come and create the experiences that will define the future of decentralized finance (DeFi).

In this role, you will work closely with the Head of Design, building a collaborative bridge between the Design and Marketing teams to help evolve, create and define our graphic design language whilst also creating visually rich content across all of RDX Works platforms.

You will not just be an order taker; we need someone who can generate ideas to solve novel needs. You will also have an experimental approach, and are open to taking risks!

What are we looking for?

  • You will enjoy working in an ambitious, fast-paced environment that requires conceptual, strategic thinking and a willingness to collaborate to create highly visible work across multiple channels.
  • You will need to have a flare for taking complex information and turning it into high quality infographics and information design solutions. We would love to see some of your best examples in your portfolio.
  • You have a keen eye for detail, strong visual design skills and a portfolio to demonstrate your inspiring creative work showcasing conceptual thinking.
  • You’ll be iterating rapidly on feedback from stakeholders across the business, so some experience in real-life constraints such as stakeholders that give you limitations and a time-based project is necessary.
  • You’ll have the willingness to take the lead on creative processes and produce new ideas, strategies and solutions that can take the RDX Works brand identity to new heights.
  • You’ll help spearhead our visual identity across social media and key marketing campaigns by crafting creative narratives across various channels.
  • You’ll be comfortable providing eye-catching design solutions for advertising, online, print collateral and publications, whilst keeping centred around the RDX Works brand mission.
  • Integrate closely with the Design and Marketing team to ensure that the brand is fully represented across all communication channels.

What do you need?

  • A portfolio of inspiring creative work showcasing conceptual thinking and strong visual design skills (including illustration and marketing focused works).
  • Demonstrable experience owning the creative process for marketing graphic design projects.
  • Ability to create work in multiple styles across print and digital.
  • Comfortable collaborating with various stakeholders in the business, whilst bringing your expertise to.
  • Proficient in Adobe CC.
  • Strong visual design skills.
  • Experience designing for social channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube etc).
  • Good understanding of design principles, typography and colour theory.
  • Strong demonstrable experience and knowledge in graphic information design (eg. infographics)

Who are we?

At RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.

Alternatively, if you feel like you don’t match all of the requirements, we would love you to still apply anyway. We understand that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates and we wouldn’t want this to prevent us from meeting you; especially as we are big advocates of helping people learn & grow.
